'''Cheerlet''' is a [[Lightning]] type [[Support]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Cheerling]] at 6 bronze stars, and evolves into [[Cheerspring]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

== Overview ==
Current Description: "To become a true idol, hard work is a must. Cheerlet practices dancing every day to reach perfection!"

Cheerlet is a gold rarity Tatari with an emphasis on bolstering its allies.

== Appearance ==
A white, bipedal rabbit with large, red eyes. Its body is covered in purple fur which grows darker on its ears, which droop downward. The ends of its ears have yellow, star-shaped fur. It wears a purple and orange, broken eggshell that covers just its lower abdomen.

Cheerlet's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces the yellow star-shaped fur on its ears with a cyan color. Additionally, the star patches on the eggshell lose their color.

== Evolution Trial ==
Cheerlet's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into [[Cheerspring]], you need to complete the following two tasks:
* Feed Cheerlet to increase stats 3 times.
* Play Treasure Hunt (dig up 70 treasure) or Cozy Farm (use x4200 fertilizer).
For the 2nd task, progress is maintained across both Treasure Hunt and Cozy Farm (I.e. Digging up treasure will reduce the amount of fertilizer required and vice versa).

==Strategy ==
[[File:Cheerlet Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Cheerlet's Attack Range]]
The ATK & DEF boost from evolving goes a long way in increasing Cheerlet's power, since the ATK & DEF boost from its skill is based on Cheerlet's own ATK & DEF. This augments its ability to make your other Tataris stronger, enabling them to take hits that they would otherwise crumple against.

The Invincibility effect is largely situational, though can allow some more fragile frontliners (Such as [[Voltkit]] or [[Kittazap]] and their evolutions) to clutch against large groups of enemies.
{{clear|left}}

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "When you're not fighting Zobos, Cheerlet, go after your dreams. After all, Trainers aren't monsters."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Cheerlets hop around endlessly in the first three days post-hatch, leaving trainers struggling to keep up. The stars on the ears glow in the dark."
